subject.title: fix: stabilize embedded prompt caching and native Responses continuation

question: Should all ambient `room_event` turns use the safe non-owner owner-only core-tool inventory to preserve one cache-stable prompt/tool contract across sender changes?
rationale: The source and upstream contracts support the implementation, but hiding owner-only tools from owner-sent ambient turns is an intentional compatibility and product-policy choice that code review cannot decide.

options.title: Accept Stable Safe Inventory
options.body: Rebase and land the current contract while preserving direct-owner tool visibility and runtime authorization.

options.title: Preserve Owner Event Tools
options.body: Require another cache-stability design that keeps owner-only tools prompt-visible for owner-sent ambient events.

options.title: Pause the Policy Change
options.body: Defer the PR if the ambient owner-tool compatibility tradeoff is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept Stable Safe Inventory
recommendation.body: Rebase and land the current contract while preserving direct-owner tool visibility and runtime authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans the central agent-tool, reply, stream-routing, and Codex lifecycle surfaces involved in this policy choice.
